removed.reason: No mention of hijacking execution flow or persistence mechanism.
Dropbox is an application-layer service, not a non-application layer protocol.
Only counts infected computers via Dropbox tokens; no OS or hardware discovery described.
No transfer of tools or files into the compromised environment is described.
Remote control via Dropbox is not described as logging into remote services with valid accounts.
No manipulation of names, locations, or artifacts to appear legitimate is described.
No spearphishing email or malicious attachment is mentioned.
No compression or encryption of collected data prior to exfiltration is described.
